topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Of course, feel free to plant away! I love the idea of colorful blooms and fresh veggies just beyond my window. It’ll be like having a living tapestry out there, and the butterflies and bees will adore it. I can practically hear them buzzing with excitement already. We could even swap some of the harvest—I’d love to try a tomato fresh from the vine, and perhaps you’d enjoy some of my home-baked bread. It’ll be a treat to see the garden grow and flourish together.
